review_basis: Original SAP-C03 Module 02 WebP slides 01–08 individually inspected. Narration follows the diagrams, real labels, examples and caveats rather than generic module summaries.

scenes.title: Preventive, proactive and detective controls
scenes.visual_overview: Guide through the original diagram, its components and the concrete governance decision depicted.
visual_walkthrough: Identify the complete architectural goal and main components
Trace the visual boxes, links, examples, alternative paths and guards in their printed order
Explain which policy or service is responsible and why the decision matters
scenes.visual_example: Use the specific original slide's pictured account, organizational unit, policy, service and outcome.
scenes.visual_synthesis: Choose a governable multi-account architecture that preserves correct permission boundaries and centralized visibility.
scenes.narration: Three side-by-side controls distinguish an SCP that blocks an API call, a proactive validation blocking a proposed resource and a Config rule flagging deployed drift.
